summary: Filter bar sits on the same row as the tabs, so collapsing it frees no space
A page search typed on Work Orders is remembered forever and empties the list on a later visit
On a phone, a shared filter link shows the filters as on but lists the wrong work orders
On a phone there is no Clear Filters button, so filters cannot all be cleared at once
When only a page search is active the empty screen offers Clear Filters, which does not help
